name: p11_field_remap_pad_buttons_for_minigame
summary: Remaps directional/face pad bits (0x1000..0x8000) in g_ovl11_saved_pad_mask and g_farm_player_controller_field_tick_state based on mode g_farm_field_remap_pad_buttons_sound_counter and g_farm_player_controller_field_value, and injects 0x20 when stick threshold g_io_active_pad_buf_ptr+0x34 > 0x55.

name: p11_field_probe_ground_ahead_of_player
summary: Probes actor interaction ahead via p11_field_probe_actor_interaction_ahead, checks tile attributes one step ahead using offset table 0x80123110 via hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection, and updates g_farm_field_probe_ground_ahead_execute_state.

name: p11_crop_apply_tool_pattern_to_tiles
summary: Determines active area grid via p11_field_get_active_plot_grid_kind, resolves world-to-tile offsets through g_farm_crop_apply_tool_pattern_field_fn_ptr, iterates 9 pattern offsets via p11_spr_find_tool_pattern_cell_offset, checks obstacle via p11_spr_is_tile_blocked_or_oob, and applies tool action via p11_spr_plant_seed_on_tilled_tile.

name: p11_field_use_hoe_on_target_tiles
summary: Executes a hoe swing at the player's target coordinates: checks collision via p11_field_get_active_plot_grid_kind, queues tile till dispatch via p11_field_set_tool_effect_anim_params using table 0x8012319c, and updates tool state.

name: p11_field_use_watering_can_on_tiles
summary: Consumes watering can water capacity (+0x88) based on charge level from 0x801231a8, computes target farm tiles via g_farm_crop_apply_tool_pattern_field_fn_ptr, and queues watering dispatch via p11_field_set_tool_effect_anim_params.

name: p11_field_use_sickle_on_target_tiles
summary: Performs a sickle cut against colliding objects via p11_evt_try_throw_held_item_at_prop or field tiles via g_farm_crop_apply_tool_pattern_field_fn_ptr and p11_field_set_tool_effect_anim_params, adding tool experience when successful.

name: p11_field_consume_and_hold_inventory_item
summary: Selects equipped held slot (+0x84) or rucksack slot (+0x90 + slot_idx*6), triggers hold emote 0x15/0x47 via hm_ovl11_trigger_player_emote, transfers item via p11_spr_copy_item_slot_6b, sets flag 0x8000, and plays SFX 7.

name: p11_field_use_fishing_rod_or_lure
summary: Triggers the item-use sound effect (8), clears held/busy flags, and enters the player throw/drop action state when holding item IDs 0x6d or 0x6e.

name: p11_field_set_tool_effect_anim_params
summary: Stores active tool effect timer (0x28), coordinates, kind, and payload across g_farm_field_tool_effect_params_queued_state_tile_fx..g_farm_field_tool_effect_params_queued_state_3.

name: p11_field_step_queued_tool_tile_fx
summary: Processes one queued tile index per frame in 0x80128cb4..0x80128cb8 for hoe tilling (p11_spr_till_field_plot_tile), watering (p11_spr_water_field_or_greenhouse_tile), or sickle cutting (p11_spr_sickle_cut_field_tile) until finished.

name: p11_field_use_axe_on_target_tile
summary: Swings the axe at colliding actors via p11_evt_try_feed_silo_or_deliver_prop or field grid stumps/branches via p11_spr_harvest_or_cut_field_tile, incrementing charge hit counters in 0x80128c64 and tool experience.

name: p11_field_use_hammer_on_target_tile
summary: Swings the hammer at colliding actors via p11_evt_try_place_held_item_in_bin or field grid rocks/boulders via hm_ovl11_submit_character_shadow (0x800d88d0), updating hit counters and tool experience.

name: p11_crop_plant_flower_or_crop_seed_tile
summary: Resolves targeted tile in g_farm_field_grid (outdoor) or g_farm_greenhouse_grid (greenhouse) via p11_field_get_active_plot_grid_kind/p11_field_get_forward_offset_pos, maps flower seed IDs 0x13b..0x13d to crop types 0x3a/0x3e/0x3f, resets growth/water bytes, and sets base soil 0x167.

name: p11_field_try_unstuck_or_dismount_pos
summary: Tests all four cardinal facing directions from the player's position via p11_field_get_forward_offset_pos, ground collision (0xc080), and actor probe p11_field_probe_actor_interaction_ahead to commit the first unobstructed placement.

name: p11_field_swap_picked_held_item
summary: Updates held item state at player_state+0x8a via p11_spr_invoke_item_action_callback and p11_field_clear_held_item_slot_and_entity; on action 0x31 swaps packed item data from g_farm_field_swap_picked_held_apply_state_tool_charge/g_farm_field_swap_picked_held_apply_state_1, loads model pack via hm_ovl11_load_entity_model_pack, and updates +0x6c flags.

name: p11_field_finish_pickup_or_start_eat
summary: Completes picking up or swapping a carried item/tool, triggers throw-in-water state if item is 0x66, or calls p11_field_start_eat_held_item to eat an edible item before returning to idle.

name: p11_field_start_eat_held_item
summary: Checks whether the player's held item descriptor in 0x8006c858 has edible flags 0x1200 set, and if so initiates eating state 3 with SFX 0x4a.

name: p11_field_release_charged_tool_swing
summary: Computes the released tool charge tier from +0x18, plays the tier SFX, and transitions player action state to the corresponding swing animation.

name: p11_field_tick_player_action_substate
summary: Advances per-frame player action substates (+0x3c): carries, tool charging/overload fainting (0x16..0x1e), idle emote cancel (0x2d), bed sleep, dive jump (0x57/0x58), and splash/fade hooks.

name: p11_field_update_watercan_or_idle_anim
summary: Selects player sprite anim ID (0x1b, facing+0xf, or facing+0x13) for movement states 1, 2, or 4 and updates player_state+0x260 via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: p11_field_update_tool_carry_move_anim
summary: Selects player sprite anim ID (0x29, facing+0x2a, or facing+0x13) for movement states 1, 2, or 4 and updates player_state+0x260 via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: p11_field_update_walk_or_sprint_anim
summary: Normalizes movement state 4 to 2 on player_state+0x3c, sets out_anim_id to facing+0xac for states 2 or 4, and applies it to player_state+0x260 via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: p11_field_update_swim_or_idle_sprite_anim
summary: Maps player movement state at player_state+0x3c (1, 2, 4) to directional animation index 0x36 or facing+0x3b, calls gfx_start_screen_filter(0, 0) on state 4, and updates sprite anim at player_state+0x260 via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: p11_field_update_carry_or_mounted_sprite_anim
summary: When carry bit 0x100 in player_state+0x6c is clear selects idle/run anim 0x1c or 10 and updates facing byte +0x265; when mounted/carrying and state != 0x39 plays facing+0x3f and steps p11_pet_dog_update_carried_anim.

name: p11_field_activate_farm_tool_action
summary: Activates primary farm tools (IDs 1..0x19: hoe, sickle, axe, hammer, watering can) with charge or water-fill checks and sets the corresponding player action state.

name: p11_field_activate_care_tool_action
summary: Activates animal care tools (IDs 0x1a..0x1d: brush, milker, clippers, bell), checks livestock collision via p11_field_dispatch_tool_on_targeted_animal, sets action state 0x4d+, and plays SFX.

name: p11_field_activate_seed_bag_action
summary: Handles seed bag items (IDs 0x22..0x36), locking player control flags and entering sowing action state 0x53 with the seed table param at descriptor +0x22.

name: p11_field_activate_special_tool_or_item
summary: Dispatches special tools (0x1e..0x21 teleport/bell/basket/pedometer, 0x38..0x39 fishing rods via p11_field_start_fishing_cast_state, and 0x12d item) and copies the active tool into +0xf0.

name: p11_field_dispatch_tool_on_targeted_animal
summary: Dispatches active tool interaction (g_ovl11_active_tool_state & 0x206) against targeted animal pointer g_ovl11_tool_anim_tbl_ptr: calls p11_pet_dog_dispatch_state(&g_anim_dog_state, 0) for bit 0x200 or hm_ovl11_feed_or_pet_cow_sheep for bits 2 or 4.

name: p11_field_poll_tool_charge_input
summary: Handles tool button press and hold-to-charge (+0x18) by dispatching farm tools, animal care tools, seed bags, and special items via p11_field_activate_farm_tool_action..p11_field_activate_special_tool_or_item.

name: p11_field_try_use_held_item_input
summary: When button 0x80 is pressed while carrying an item (flag 0x10000000 and +0x8a != 0), invokes p11_field_handle_held_item_use_or_throw(1) to eat or use the held item.

name: p11_field_is_active_scene_not_indoor
summary: Queries p11_core_check_nearby_npc_greetings for the active scene descriptor and returns true when a descriptor exists and its field +0x1a type is not 2.

name: p11_field_pickup_target_into_hands
summary: Dispatches a pickup attempt against g_ovl11_active_tool_state flags (0x8, 0x20, 0x100, 0x800, 0x8000) to harvest a crop, grab an animal/item, or pull from a forage source.

name: p11_field_probe_interact_object_type
summary: Queries script interactable trigger at world_pos via p11_core_find_active_trigger_zone(g_core_event_script_ctx), stores pointer in g_farm_field_probe_interact_object_state, and returns matched type 0x26, 0x2a, 0x2b, or 0x2c (0 otherwise).

name: p11_field_offer_fish_to_lake_goddess
summary: Checks if held item at player_state+0x8a is 0x47 (large fish/offering): if so triggers throw emote 0x5c via hm_ovl11_trigger_player_emote and plays SFX 0x13, otherwise opens dialogue prompt 0x201 via hm_dialogue_set_window_state.

name: p11_field_feed_or_gift_coop_chicken
summary: Tests if held item player_state+0x8a is chicken feed via p11_spr_is_item_chicken_feed: shows dialogue 0x1a4 if false, or triggers feed emote 0x5a via hm_ovl11_trigger_player_emote when facing matches interact_ctx+8.

name: p11_field_feed_barn_livestock_fodder
summary: Tests if held item player_state+0x8a is livestock fodder via p11_spr_is_item_livestock_fodder: shows dialogue 0x1a2 if false, or triggers fodder placement emote 0x5b via hm_ovl11_trigger_player_emote when facing matches interact_ctx+8.

name: p11_field_feed_dog_or_horse_bowl
summary: Tests if held item player_state+0x8a is pet food via p11_spr_is_item_pet_feed: shows dialogue 0x1a3 if false, or triggers bowl-fill emote 0x59 via hm_ovl11_trigger_player_emote when facing matches interact_ctx+8.

name: p11_field_interact_lumber_shed
summary: Deposits held lumber (0x3f/0x13d) into the lumber store via p11_evt_add_fodder_count or withdraws one piece of lumber into hands if empty-handed and lumber stock exists.

name: p11_field_deposit_item_into_shipping_bin
summary: Handles shipping bin drop at player_state+0x8a == 0x69: checks player facing (+0x38) against bin_ctx+8 (including diagonal directions 6 and 7), sets flag 0x4000, plays SFX 7, triggers emote 0x5e, and spawns bin entry via p11_field_mark_animal_daily_checked.

name: p11_field_deposit_basket_into_shipping_bin
summary: Handles basket/secondary shipping bin interaction at player_state+0x8a == 0x68: validates player facing (+0x38) against bin_ctx+8, sets flag 0x4000, plays SFX 7, triggers emote 0x5f, and calls p11_field_mark_animal_daily_checked(..., 1) or shows dialogue 0x1e4.

name: p11_field_toss_or_discard_held_item
summary: Validates held item at player_state+0x8a against sprite descriptor table g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr (flags 0x9000 or invalid slot -1): opens prompt 0x20a if empty, else triggers discard emote 0x61 and plays SFX 9.

name: p11_field_match_and_fire_zone_trigger
summary: Checks whether player position matches a zone entry via p11_core_find_nearby_npc_actor, validates trigger ID (+0x04) and facing (+0x08), and fires dialogue 0x16 or event zone 3 with flag 0x46.

name: p11_field_interact_fodder_silo
summary: Withdraws animal fodder (0x68) from the barn silo when empty-handed, deposits held fodder via p11_evt_add_chicken_feed_count, or displays the fodder count message 0x19c.

name: p11_field_interact_chicken_feed_silo
summary: Withdraws chicken feed (0x69) from the coop dispenser when empty-handed, deposits held chicken feed via p11_evt_add_festival_medal_count, or displays the feed count message 0x19f.

name: p11_field_deposit_lumber_or_fodder_into_silo
summary: Checks fodder/item type (0x125 -> 2, 0xe8 -> 1, else 0) via p11_spr_is_item_livestock_fodder and deposits via p11_field_assign_pregnant_or_isolated_slot(bin_slot, kind); on success clears carry bits 0xc000 on +0x6c, triggers emote 0x66, and returns 1, else shows dialogue.

name: p11_field_dispatch_farm_pad_shortcuts
summary: Handles farm UI and action pad shortcuts when g_core_map_transition_state is 0: dispatches overlay shortcuts 0x100/0x800/0x10 via p11_ui_open_town_map_overlay/p11_ui_trigger_stamina_warning_sfx/p11_ui_open_rucksack_pause_menu and ground raycast/pickup 0x40 via hm_ovl11_raycast_ground_height and hm_ovl11_handle_item_pickup_carry.

name: p11_field_try_pickup_front_target
summary: Attempts to pick up an item or entity ahead via p11_field_pickup_target_into_hands, and if an item ID is returned equips it into player hands via hm_ovl11_use_equipped_tool_on_tile.

name: p11_field_handle_action_button_item_op
summary: Handles pressing action button 0x40: either uses/gives/throws the currently carried item via p11_field_handle_held_item_use_or_throw(0) or picks up a target via p11_field_try_pickup_front_target when bit 0x2000 is set.

name: p11_field_equip_first_rucksack_item
summary: Scans 8 rucksack item slots (+0x90 stride 6) and hands slot (+0x84), clears carry flags, packs/rotates slots via p11_field_compact_rucksack_items and p11_field_sync_rucksack_items_equipped(0), then transfers the equipped item via p11_spr_copy_item_slot_6b, triggers emote 0x15/0x47, and plays SFX 7.

name: p11_field_cycle_or_stow_held_item
summary: Cycles a non-empty rucksack slot into the player's hands with action 10 and SFX 7 via p11_field_sync_rucksack_tools_equipped, or stows the currently held item if p11_spr_is_item_edible_or_holdable permits.

name: p11_field_check_inspect_object_trigger
summary: Inspects nearby interactable objects flagged 0x80 in g_ovl11_active_tool_state and triggers event zone 3 or 9 while recording the target object ID in player +0x22.

name: p11_field_start_swim_dive_state
summary: Transitions the player into action state 0x3b with fixed X/Y velocity, facing 2, sprite animation 4, flag 0x40000000, and plays SFX 6.

name: p11_field_try_start_idle_yawn_emote
summary: Triggers player idle yawn/stretch action state 0x54 once idle timer +0x1a exceeds 100 frames and no input or carry/overlay flags block it.

name: p11_field_map_pad_dpad_to_cardinal_dir
summary: Maps D-pad bitmask values (0x1000..0xc000) to player cardinal direction indices 0..3, returning fallback_dir if no valid direction matches.

name: p11_field_apply_step_velocity_from_dir
summary: Selects directional velocity table g_farm_field_apply_velocity_dir_probe_count..g_farm_field_apply_velocity_dir_value_2 by movement state player_state+0x3c (2 or 4) and carry bit 0x100 on +0x6c, adding delta XZ into player_state+0x110 and +0x118.

name: p11_field_update_player_walk_run_input
summary: Reads directional and run-button masks from g_ovl11_saved_pad_mask, updates player facing via p11_field_map_pad_dpad_to_cardinal_dir, applies walk/run velocities via p11_field_apply_step_velocity_from_dir, and sets action state 1/2/4.

name: p11_field_preload_equipped_tool_and_item_models
summary: Preloads entity model packs via hm_ovl11_load_entity_model_pack for the 2 hand slots at g_core_player_state_action_sub_vars_idx10, 8 rucksack tool slots at g_player_rucksack_tools, and 8 rucksack item slots at g_core_player_state_mount_and_interact_vars_idx2 (stride 6 bytes each).

name: p11_field_init_minigame_player_tools
summary: Resets tool animation pointers and pad masks, initializes debug/minigame rucksack item and tool slots when engine flag 0x8000 is set, and resets player position via p11_field_get_house_upgrade_spawn_xz.

name: p11_field_stop_player_velocity_and_lock
summary: Zeroes player velocity globals g_core_player_state_vel_y/14/18 and clears lock bit 0x40000000 in g_player_status_flags.

name: p11_field_get_active_plot_grid_kind
summary: Returns active tillable grid kind (1 for greenhouse map 6, 0 for map 1, or 2 for outdoor farm plot).

name: p11_field_compact_rucksack_tools
summary: Compacts the 8-slot rucksack tools array at g_player_rucksack_tools by calling p11_field_compact_inventory_slots(&g_player_rucksack_tools, 8).

name: p11_field_compact_rucksack_items
summary: Compacts the 8-slot rucksack items array at g_core_player_state_mount_and_interact_vars_idx2 by calling p11_field_compact_inventory_slots(&g_core_player_state_mount_and_interact_vars_idx2, 8).

name: p11_field_sync_rucksack_tools_equipped
summary: Synchronizes the 8-slot rucksack tool array g_player_rucksack_tools with the equipped tool slot at 0x80071a8a via p11_field_rotate_rucksack_ring_buffer(..., clear_mode != 0) and returns 1.

name: p11_field_sync_rucksack_items_equipped
summary: Synchronizes the 8-slot rucksack item array g_core_player_state_mount_and_interact_vars_idx2 with equipped item g_core_player_state_action_sub_vars_idx10 via p11_field_rotate_rucksack_ring_buffer(..., clear_mode != 0) and returns 1.

name: p11_field_draw_cursor_or_marker_quad
summary: Sets g_gfx_sprite_ot_ctx sprite animation state to 0x18 via hm_sprite_set_anim_state, zeroes g_npc_field_cursor_marker_quad_dlg_flag, and submits the 0x0e sprite quad at (screen_x, screen_y) using hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad.

name: p11_field_draw_carried_item_sprite
summary: Computes carry-pose screen offsets from table 0x8012315c based on player action (+0x3c) and facing (+0x38), then submits the carried item sprite via hm_ovl11_spawn_render_entity.

name: p11_field_render_player_sprite_and_charge
summary: Submits either the main player character sprite with tool-charge palette overrides (modes 0x17..0x1f) via gfx_sprite_emit_char_frame or the alternate overlay sprite at +0x290 via gfx_sprite_draw_save_retaddr.

name: p11_field_update_splash_fx_position
summary: Copies the player's current world position (+0x100..+0x10c) into the active splash/effect slot at 0x80128cf4 and refreshes its sprite via hm_ovl11_spawn_soil_splash_fx.

name: p11_field_sync_carried_entity_sprite_anim
summary: Syncs carried/targeted animal actor g_farm_execute_player_action_try_field_lut32 facing (+0x22) and sprite anim state (+0x78) from player_state movement (+0x3c) and carry anim (+0x264) via hm_sprite_set_anim_state.

name: p11_field_tick_player_idle_sleep_counter
summary: Increments idle/sleep counter at player_state+0x1a when status flags +0x6c match idle conditions, or resets it to 0.

name: p11_field_resolve_player_wall_slide
summary: Applies player velocity lookahead, triggers fence/obstacle vaulting or push checks via p11_field_probe_actor_interaction_ahead, and computes diagonal wall-sliding velocities from table 0x80123270.

name: p11_field_integrate_player_physics
summary: Resolves player wall collisions via p11_field_resolve_player_wall_slide, applies jump/dive arc gravity and ground landing checks, clamps spawn pos via p11_spr_clamp_pos_to_camera_bounds, and projects camera target matrix.

name: p11_field_compact_inventory_slots
summary: Left-shifts non-zero 6-byte item/tool entries inside slot_array up to slot_count, collapsing empty zero-ID gaps and returning 0.

name: p11_field_rotate_rucksack_ring_buffer
summary: Cycles 6-byte inventory records forward or backward between slot_array (up to slot_count) and equipped_slot using p11_field_compact_inventory_slots compaction and memmove.

name: p11_field_get_tool_sprite_anim_base
summary: Maps equipped tool_id ranges (1..0x19 upgraded tools, 0x1a..0x1d secondary tools) to their player sprite animation base ID.

name: p11_field_get_tool_family_index
summary: Maps equipped tool_id (1..0x19 -> 0..4 upgrade group, 0x1a..0x1d -> 0..3) to its tool family index.

name: p11_field_probe_actor_interaction_ahead
summary: Queries actor/wall collision ahead of the player via p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget, handles push/vault interaction and animal/item hit flags in 0x80128c54/0x80128c4c, and returns collision status.

name: p11_field_try_pocket_held_item
summary: Attempts to stash the carried item into the rucksack via p11_field_compact_rucksack_tools when flag 0x10000000 is set, or calls hm_ovl11_add_player_fatigue_penalty to reset action state.

name: p11_field_equip_and_show_gift_item
summary: Clears and copies item_slot into player temp slot 0x80071af0 via p11_spr_zero_item_slot_6b/p11_spr_copy_item_slot_6b and enters action state 0x30 to present/hold the item.

name: p11_field_begin_tool_charge_prep
summary: Samples forward tool target via p11_field_get_forward_offset_pos(player_state, pos, 0), resets g_farm_field_begin_tool_charge_value to 0, and returns action code 3.

name: p11_field_handle_held_item_use_or_throw
summary: Handles using/eating (mode != 0) or giving/placing/throwing (mode == 0) the held item at 0x80071a88, dispatching NPC gifts, basket/horse/bin deposits, dog ball, or ground toss.

name: p11_field_release_held_item_slot
summary: Drops an active world entity (+0x8a with flag 0x100) ahead of the player via p11_field_drop_carried_entity_at_pos, clears its entity VRAM slot via hm_ovl11_clear_render_entity_slot, and zeroes +0x8a.

name: p11_field_is_player_input_unlocked
summary: Returns true when bit 0x20000000 is clear in player status flags g_player_status_flags.

name: p11_field_set_player_facing_and_prev
summary: Saves previous facing direction g_player_facing_dir into g_core_player_state_tool_exp_and_timers and updates g_player_facing_dir to facing_dir.

name: p11_field_check_shipping_or_doghouse_drop
summary: Tests collision bit 0x200 at a thrown item's landing spot via p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget when the dog state is 0x15f; if hit, registers the shipped item via p11_evt_record_shipped_item and cleans up.

name: p11_field_clear_thrown_item_slots
summary: Clears all 3 projectile/thrown item slots in g_farm_field_clear_thrown_item_spawn_value (stride 0x34) by invoking p11_field_zero_thrown_item_slot on each slot.

name: p11_field_zero_thrown_item_slot
summary: Clears all header fields, position, and velocity words in a 0x34-byte thrown-item trajectory slot.

name: p11_field_spawn_thrown_item_arc
summary: Allocates a free thrown-item slot in g_farm_field_clear_thrown_item_spawn_value (3 slots), sets parabolic velocity from g_farm_field_spawn_thrown_item_interact_value_tile/g_farm_field_spawn_thrown_item_interact_value_1 by facing_dir with overrides for item IDs 0x65 and 0x186, and returns the slot pointer.

name: p11_field_eval_fishing_cast_zone
summary: Stubbed or optimized field action check whose branches were compiled out, returning constant status 2.

name: p11_field_tick_thrown_item_slots
summary: Loops over the 3 thrown/flying item trajectory slots starting at 0x80128bb0 and updates each active slot via hm_ovl11_handle_area_door_warp.

name: p11_field_resolve_throw_or_fishing_end
summary: Clears thrown slot ID and player lock bit 0x40; if the thrown object was fishing bobber 0x186 stores splash position in 0x8012db78..0x8012db7c, else releases player held slot.

name: p11_field_latch_held_item_mount_state
summary: Reads interact target descriptor from g_core_event_script_ctx into g_player_interact_target and syncs horse carry/saddle state g_anim_horse_state_idx44/14 when held item is 0x106 or 0x107.

name: p11_field_clear_held_item_slot_and_entity
summary: Checks if item_slot is non-empty via p11_spr_add_item_slot_quantity(item_slot, -1), clears its render entity via hm_ovl11_clear_render_entity_slot, and resets the item slot via p11_spr_zero_item_slot_6b.

name: p11_field_sync_carried_item_flags
summary: Updates player status flags +0x6c based on whether +0x8a holds an item and sets bit 0x8000000 or 0x10000000 according to item flags in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr.

name: p11_field_init_player_emote_sprite
summary: Computes emote sub-index from player_state+0x3c - 0x3b, optionally reloads CD overlay asset via p11_cd_load_crop_sprite_bank, initializes sprite anim struct at player_state+0x260 from g_cd_crop_sprite_bank_animal_field_table + g_farm_field_player_emote_sprite_value[idx], and resets anim state to 0.

name: p11_field_end_player_action_lock
summary: Clears player action-lock bit 0x1000, invokes p11_core_init_farm_sprite_anim, and resets the player's action state via hm_ovl11_add_player_fatigue_penalty.

name: p11_field_get_house_upgrade_spawn_xz
summary: Reads house upgrade level g_farm_weather_festival and writes corresponding (x, 0, z) spawn offset from g_farm_field_house_upgrade_spawn_table_1/g_farm_field_house_upgrade_spawn_table_2 into out_pos.

name: p11_field_calc_effective_stamina_cost
summary: Adjusts tool stamina base_cost for bad weather (g_farm_current_weather), late hours (g_farm_cal_hour < 6 or 22..23), zero stamina, Power Berry half-cost bit 0x200, or invulnerability flag 8.

name: p11_field_trigger_scheduled_bell_chime
summary: When g_player_status_flags bit 0x400000 is clear, scans 4 hour entries in g_farm_field_trigger_scheduled_bell_value against g_farm_cal_hour and triggers audio/chime event via p11_spr_apply_stamina_fatigue_happiness.

name: p11_field_get_fatigue_tint_alpha
summary: Maps player fatigue level at player_state+0x16 (<50: 0, <70: 0x78, <80: 0xf0, <=99: 0x168, >99: 0) to fatigue warning threshold.

name: p11_field_calc_fishing_tension_decay
summary: Computes downward/negative fishing tension step (-5 - (fish_timer / 60) * 2), clamped at -0x80.

name: p11_field_calc_fishing_reel_power
summary: Computes upward/positive fishing reel step ((fish_timer / 60) * 7 + 0x32), clamped at 0x7f.

name: p11_field_add_tool_experience
summary: Adds xp_delta (saturated to 0xffff) to the equipped tool proficiency slot at player_state+0x40 + ((tool_id - 1)/5)*2 when flag bit 8 in +0x36 is clear.

name: p11_field_check_player_warp_zone_and_enter
summary: Tests player warp trigger on g_core_player_state via p11_field_get_fatigue_tint_alpha (defaulting -1 to 0), latches minute g_farm_cal_day_minutes into g_core_player_state_pad_0x2a_idx1, and calls area transition p11_core_schedule_wakeup_fade_delay.

name: p11_field_start_scripted_walk_turn
summary: Starts a scripted player walk/turn sequence toward target_scene_anim when unlocked, setting status bits 0xa and entering walk action state 2.

name: p11_field_apply_scripted_pad_override
summary: When cutscene control bit 8 is set in player_state+0x6c, clears g_farm_player_controller_field_tick_state and loads scripted pad mask g_farm_field_apply_scripted_pad_table[player_state+0x30] into g_ovl11_saved_pad_mask.

name: p11_field_check_stamina_fatigue_emots
summary: Evaluates stamina (+0x12 vs +0x14 thresholds) and fatigue (+0x16 at 50/80/100) threshold crossings in flags +0x36, triggering collapse/sweat animations or calling p11_animl_run_pet_event_wait_loop.

name: p11_field_check_exit_trigger_and_warp
summary: Checks engine/player busy flags, raycasts ground exit trigger via hm_ovl11_raycast_ground_height(&g_gfx_active_map_desc, player_state+0x100, 1), validates door/area entry via p11_ovl_resolve_npc_talk_or_door and hm_event_flag_get, and triggers prompt p11_field_start_scripted_walk_turn or warp in g_core_map_transition_state.

name: p11_field_start_fishing_cast_state
summary: Enters fishing cast action state 0x45, plays SFX 0xf, spawns the bobber particle at 0x186, and initializes fishing minigame globals in 0x8012db78..0x8012db88 based on rod tier (+0x84).

name: p11_field_reset_sweat_and_ambient_particles
summary: Copies player position (+0x100..0x108) into 10 particle entries (+0x120 stride 0x10), zeroes counter +0x32, and initializes 5 particle anim structs (+0x2d4 stride 0x34) from g_farm_festival_field_vram_sweat_crop_table via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_field_render_sweat_drop_particles
summary: Iterates over 5 particle slots starting at player_state+0x120 (stride 0x10) and renders/steps each active mode-0 particle via p11_field_render_and_step_particle_slot; always returns 0.

name: p11_field_clear_ambient_particles
summary: Resets all 10 ambient particle slots (+0x1c0 stride 0x10 and +0x3d4 stride 4) to state 5 at player_state+0x100..+0x10c and returns 0.

name: p11_field_render_ambient_field_particles
summary: Iterates over 10 ambient particle slots at player_state+0x1c0 (stride 0x10) whose state at player_state+0x3d4+i*4 is not 5 and renders each mode-1 particle via p11_field_render_and_step_particle_slot; always returns 0.

name: p11_field_get_forward_offset_pos
summary: Offsets player world coordinates (+0x100..+0x108) along facing +0x38 using reach table g_farm_field_forward_offset_pos_dig_count or g_farm_field_forward_offset_pos_value (halved when reach_mode == 4) into out_pos.

name: p11_field_render_and_step_particle_slot
summary: Projects particle world pos + (0x96, -100, -0x96) via hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos, draws sprite primitive from player_state+0x2d4 or g_farm_field_render_particle_slot_winter_value via gfx_sprite_draw_save_retaddr, and advances frame via hm_sprite_step_0x0e_frame when mode_flag == 0.

name: p11_field_start_sleep_bed_cutscene
summary: Starts the player go-to-bed sequence (action state 0x4a), sets event flag 9, computes bed destination offsets via p11_field_get_barn_or_coop_spawn_pos, and arms day-end fade globals.

name: p11_field_get_barn_or_coop_spawn_pos
summary: Selects map spawn preset 0..2 from active map ID *(g_core_event_script_ctx+4) (0x54..0x5b) and writes g_farm_field_barn_coop_spawn_count_1/g_farm_field_barn_coop_spawn_count_2 (x, 0, z) into out_pos.

name: p11_field_step_jump_arc_interpolation
summary: Interpolates a 17-step jump arc between g_farm_field_start_sleep_bed_jump_value and g_farm_field_start_sleep_bed_jump_cfg via hm_clut_lerp_rgb_triple, updates player position (+0x100..+0x108) and g_core_spawn_pos_x..a8, and clears g_core_engine_flags0 bit 0x400000 on completion.

name: p11_field_is_item_edible_crop_group
summary: Returns true if item_id is in the 6-item edible/tool subrange 0xed..0xf2.

name: p11_field_get_seed_season_index
summary: Returns signed 16-bit offset (item_id - 0x70) used to map tool/seed item IDs.

name: p11_field_is_item_seed_bag
summary: Returns true if item_id falls within the 6-item seed bag range 0x7d..0x82.

name: p11_field_snap_pos_to_valid_ground_y
summary: Iterates height offsets in table 0x801232c8 via hm_res_gfx_reset_world_spr and hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection until a passable ground elevation is found, updating world_pos[1].

name: p11_field_init_winter_pond_sprite
summary: Resets g_farm_player_movement_field_value to 0, then in winter (g_farm_calendar_clock == 3) checks sprite asset 0x187 via p11_spr_find_area_prop_sprite_data, sets g_farm_player_movement_field_value = 1, and initializes g_farm_field_render_particle_slot_winter_value via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_field_step_demo_input_playback
summary: Advances attract-mode/demo input buffer g_ovl27_field_demo_input_playback_dispatch_state up to 0x738 frames when flags 0x8000/0x10000 in g_core_engine_flags0 are active, then sets g_core_map_transition_state = 0x1a.

name: p11_field_update_farm_world_and_bgm
summary: Runs world tick updates for ground pickups, wild critters, crop growth, shipping/upgrades, and weather FX, then starts queued CD-XA stream 0x8007621e when ready.

name: p11_field_reset_all_animal_and_pickup_slots
summary: Clears chicken, barn livestock, critter, pickup, horse, dog, shipping markers, and breeding slot tables, spawns the initial horse entity (0x107), and resets animal counters.

name: p11_field_step_all_farm_entities
summary: Updates all active chickens (10 slots at 0x800742ec), barn livestock (20 slots at 0x800749f4), and ground pickups (6 slots at 0x80075bc4) when scene flag bit 3 is clear.

name: p11_field_pickup_world_entity_or_horse
summary: Handles picking up a carryable world entity (checking p11_spr_has_item_flag_0x8100), locking it for player carry or dismounting/claiming a horse state via p11_npc_adjust_affection_wrapper and hm_ovl11_query_pasture_tile_grass.

name: p11_field_place_entity_and_project_ground
summary: Clears entity lock bit 0x20000, writes an unaligned 32-bit attribute/facing value at +0x2e, copies transform_pos to +0x38..+0x44, and queries ground height via hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection.

name: p11_field_drop_carried_entity_at_pos
summary: Places a carried chicken, cow/sheep, horse, or ground item back into the world via p11_field_place_entity_and_project_ground, assigning basket/fish/truffle states or clearing invalid dropped items.

name: p11_field_is_entity_type_valid_in_zone
summary: Obtains current area mask from p11_field_get_season_bitmask and scans the 17-entry table g_farm_field_entity_type_valid_spawn_value (stride 0x18) to check if entity_type is permitted in the active zone.

name: p11_field_clear_held_flag_if_not_carried
summary: Clears carried flag 0x20000 in entity_rec+0x34 if the player's carried item at g_player_held_item+2 no longer matches *entity_rec.

name: p11_field_set_pending_animal_alert
summary: Stores pending animal alert category alert_kind into g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_pending_state.

name: p11_field_spawn_dog_at_player_pos
summary: Writes dog position (g_anim_dog_state_idx56/10/14) and area state (g_anim_dog_state_idx44/04) in g_anim_dog_state and resets player emote/state via p11_ovl_reset_entity_state_pair(player_state+0xa8).

name: p11_field_clear_world_entity_slots
summary: Loops over the 6 world actor/prop slots at g_farm_actor_collision_field_all_cfg (stride 0xb0) and clears matching slots via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot, respecting bit 0x20000 and wild-dog flag 0x1000000 in g_npc_event_progress_flags.

name: p11_field_spawn_seasonal_map_items
summary: Calls p11_field_spawn_wild_critters_stub and p11_field_spawn_map_forage_pickups, then in sunny weather iterates 17 seasonal forage entries in 0x80123758 matched by p11_field_get_season_bitmask and spawns them via hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup.

name: p11_field_spawn_wild_critters_stub
summary: No-op stub function (optimized out / unreachable critter spawn block) returning immediately in wave 8 of farm_crops_field.

name: p11_field_spawn_map_forage_pickups
summary: Iterates up to 6 entries in table 0x80123940 and spawns wild/forageable ground items (including truffle 0x17a gated on flag 0x80076210) with randomized facing via hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup.

name: p11_field_roll_spawn_bug_or_forage_drop
summary: During sunny non-winter weather, rolls a 1-in-50 chance to spawn a field drop (0x156 or 0x157) at the disturbed tile coordinates via hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup.

name: p11_field_roll_wild_dog_spawn_flag
summary: Checks if outdoor livestock or chickens exist via p11_field_find_outdoor_animal_slot(0/1), weather g_farm_current_weather is clear (0), season g_farm_calendar_clock is not winter (3), and rolls 1-in-10 chance via hm_prng_next to set wild dog bit 0x800000 in g_npc_event_progress_flags.

name: p11_field_test_animal_health_bitmask
summary: Checks sick bit 0x100 and flag bit 0x80000 in animal_rec+0x34 against query bits 1 and 2 of health_mask, returning 1 on match.

name: p11_field_query_any_animal_flag_match
summary: Tests cows/sheep in g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (bits 1/2) and chickens in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl (bit 4) via p11_field_test_animal_health_bitmask(..., target_area), returning 1 on the first matching animal.

name: p11_field_reset_animals_for_festival_day
summary: Removes event-flagged livestock and chickens from the active field via p11_barn_cow_zero_actor and p11_coop_chicken_zero_actor, dropping any carried chicken first and incrementing weather/state counters.

name: p11_field_spawn_shipping_bin_markers
summary: Spawns up to three actor entities (type 0x109, state 0x30) at coordinates from table 0x801239d0 via p11_coop_chicken_spawn_in_world.

name: p11_field_render_animal_actor_sprite
summary: Projects an animal actor's position via hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos, draws its emote/carried icons and main sprite, submits its shadow via p11_field_submit_entity_shadow_if_enabled, and advances its animation frame.

name: p11_field_render_npc_or_livestock_mesh
summary: Projects an NPC or large livestock actor, submits its 3D/billboard sprite quad via gfx_sprite_emit_active_char and emotion icon via p11_ovl_draw_countdown_fx_quad, projects ground shadow when flag 0x1000000 is set, and steps animation.

name: p11_field_submit_entity_shadow_if_enabled
summary: Calls p11_field_draw_cursor_or_marker_quad to draw a shadow quad at screen coordinates when bit 12 (0x1000) of entity_flags is clear, passing bit 31 as the shadow size selector.

name: p11_field_integrate_vec3_velocity
summary: Adds 3D vector vel_vec to pos_vec and zeroes vel_vec when keep_velocity == 0.

name: p11_field_show_high_affection_heart_bubble
summary: When animal affection at animal_rec+0x16 is >= 10, displays heart emote (0x25, 0x2d) on animal_rec+0xa8 via p11_ovl_set_entity_state_pair.

name: p11_field_compare_axis_sign
summary: Returns 0 if cur_coord == target_coord, 1 if cur_coord < target_coord, or 2 if cur_coord >= target_coord.

name: p11_field_get_target_octant_direction
summary: Compares X (+0x38 vs +0x58) and Z (+0x40 vs +0x60) signs via p11_field_compare_axis_sign and indexes into the 3x3 direction lookup table g_farm_field_target_octant_direction_table.

name: p11_field_face_entity_toward_target
summary: Compares |dx| vs |dz| between current pos (+0x38, +0x3c) and target (+0x58, +0x5c), queries octant via p11_field_get_target_octant_direction, and writes the best cardinal direction (0..3) into entity_rec+0x22.

name: p11_field_place_animal_in_outdoor_zone
summary: Places an outdoor animal record at its pasture/yard slot by dispatching to p11_field_place_barn_animal_in_pasture for barn livestock (is_barn == 1) or p11_field_place_coop_chicken_in_yard(animal_rec, slot_idx) for coop poultry.

name: p11_field_sync_outdoor_animals_from_tables
summary: Synchronizes outdoor animal placement via p11_field_place_animal_in_outdoor_zone across the 20 barn livestock entries in g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (state 5) or 10 chicken coop entries in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl (state 4), plus the 2 special slots referenced by g_farm_field_sync_outdoor_animals_alloc_table/g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_sync_cfg16.

name: p11_field_alloc_pregnant_animal_slot
summary: Scans pregnancy tracking slots g_farm_field_sync_outdoor_animals_alloc_table (indices 0..1 for cows gated by g_farm_upgrade_flags0, or indices 2..3 for sheep gated by g_farm_upgrade_flags1) and returns the first free (-1) pair.

name: p11_field_deliver_newborn_animals
summary: Processes completed pregnancy/incubation slots in 0x80076200, waking newborn cows/sheep via p11_barn_cow_init_barn_slot/p11_barn_sheep_init_barn_slot or respawning hatched chicks at incubator coordinates.

name: p11_field_check_breeding_slot_status
summary: Returns 2 if barn/coop breeding slot slot_idx is locked by upgrade flags g_farm_upgrade_flags0/g_farm_upgrade_flags1, else returns 1 if g_farm_field_sync_outdoor_animals_alloc_table[slot_idx*2] is occupied.

name: p11_field_find_free_barn_animal_slot
summary: Scans up to 10 (or 20 if g_farm_upgrade_flags0 != 0) records in g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (stride 0xb8) for an empty un-reserved slot (*rec == 0 and bit 0x2000000 clear).

name: p11_field_find_free_coop_chicken_slot
summary: Scans up to 5 (or 10 if g_farm_upgrade_flags1 != 0) records in g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl (stride 0xb4) for an empty un-reserved slot (*rec == 0 and bit 0x2000000 clear).

name: p11_field_get_barn_animal_slot_index
summary: Finds index 0..19 of animal_rec inside g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (stride 0xb8), or returns -1 if not found.

name: p11_field_set_breeding_pair_entry
summary: Stores animal_idx and days_left into a 2-short breeding/incubator slot entry.

name: p11_field_clear_breeding_pair_entry
summary: Resets both halfwords of a breeding/incubator pair entry to 0xffff.

name: p11_field_show_animal_status_dialogue
summary: Formats animal name (+4) and remaining days/hearts (+0xb2) into g_farm_field_show_animal_status_value via hm_text_fetch_script_entry and opens animal status dialogue (0x6bd..0x6c4) via hm_dialogue_set_window_state.

name: p11_field_mark_animal_daily_checked
summary: Sets daily interaction byte at slot_idx in g_farm_field_mark_animal_daily_checked_state (barn) or g_farm_field_mark_animal_daily_checked_counter (coop) to 1.

name: p11_field_is_animal_daily_checked
summary: Returns 1 if daily check byte slot_idx is non-zero in g_farm_field_mark_animal_daily_checked_state (is_barn == 1) or g_farm_field_mark_animal_daily_checked_counter (coop), else 0.

name: p11_field_assign_pregnant_or_isolated_slot
summary: Checks slot availability via p11_field_check_breeding_slot_status, allocates free barn animal via p11_field_find_free_coop_chicken_slot, sets bit 0x2000000, records slot ID in g_farm_field_sync_outdoor_animals_alloc_table/g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_sync_cfg16 via p11_coop_chicken_get_slot_index, and returns 0 or error message ID.

name: p11_field_return_pasture_animals_inside
summary: Checks whether horse, dog, 20 barn livestock, and 10 coop chickens are parked on outdoor return/coop tiles via p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget and teleports them back inside the barn, coop, or house yard.

name: p11_field_set_selected_animal_slot
summary: Stores selected animal slot index slot_idx into g_farm_field_world_bgm_all_selected_counter.

name: p11_field_step_entity_path_movement
summary: Steps animal/pickup movement: evaluates water probe p11_field_check_actor_water_or_zone, selects cardinal heading via p11_field_choose_entity_move_dir from forward/left/right probes (p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget, p11_field_is_tile_or_wall_blocked, p11_field_probe_entity_collision), seeks target or jumps via p11_field_step_entity_jump_arc, and runs zone transitions via p11_field_apply_entity_zone_transition.

name: p11_field_set_seek_arrival_radius
summary: Sets entity seek arrival distance threshold g_farm_field_entity_path_movement_seek_state to radius.

name: p11_field_choose_entity_move_dir
summary: Computes a farm animal or pickup actor's next cardinal direction from turn_mode (0..7) and tests wall/actor collisions via p11_field_is_tile_or_wall_blocked, p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget, and p11_field_probe_entity_collision.

name: p11_field_pick_weighted_wander_direction
summary: Rolls 0..100 via hm_prng_next against 4-entry directional probability table g_farm_field_pick_weighted_wander_value indexed by (entity_kind, cur_dir, probe_state), returning direction 0..3 or 4 if none matched.

name: p11_field_compare_seek_axis
summary: Compares cur_coord against target_coord for target seeking, returning 0 if equal, 1 if less, or 2 otherwise.

name: p11_field_compute_seek_move_mask
summary: Computes delta to target (+0x58, +0x60 vs +0x38, +0x40), clears arrive bit 0x2000 in +0x34 when within g_farm_field_entity_path_movement_seek_state tolerance, or returns movement bitmask from g_farm_field_compute_seek_move_table using p11_field_compare_seek_axis.

name: p11_field_check_actor_water_or_zone
summary: Probes zone flag 0x10 at the actor's current position via p11_core_probe_actor_ray_with_budget and toggles status bit 0x200000 on +0x34 accordingly.

name: p11_field_tick_wild_critter_slots
summary: Updates the 3 wild critter/rabbit/butterfly slots at 0x80075fe4 by calling p11_coop_chicken_tick_ai, p11_coop_chicken_clear_sprite_flags, p11_coop_chicken_update_sprite_frame, and toggling visibility timer at +0xa8.

name: p11_field_tick_all_ground_pickups
summary: Updates all 6 ground pickup slots at 0x80075bc4 via p11_field_tick_ground_pickup_slot, integrates motion via p11_field_sync_entity_velocity_to_pos, and updates sprite frames via p11_field_update_pickup_sprite_anim while uncarried.

name: p11_field_probe_entity_collision
summary: Extracts packed 3-byte entity collision bounds from entity_rec+0x2e..0x31, tests world collision via p11_core_probe_push_tile_path, and sets bit 0x1000000 in entity_rec+0x34 when hit returns 2 and set_hit_flag == 1.

name: p11_field_step_entity_jump_arc
summary: Drives a 400-unit vertical jump arc over Y (+0x3c) and Y velocity (+0x4c) in entity_rec using jump bit 0x400000 on +0x34, returning 1 while airborne and 0 on landing.

name: p11_field_step_pet_follow_and_timer
summary: While *timer_ptr < 300, updates entity target to player coordinates (g_player_pos_x/04/08/0c) via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters when lock bit 0x2000 is set, and increments *timer_ptr when state matches active_state.

name: p11_field_flush_pending_animal_interaction
summary: When g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_pending_state != -1 and p11_field_is_player_input_unlocked returns non-zero, dispatches pending animal state update via p11_field_update_animal_fence_alerts((int)g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_pending_state) and resets g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_pending_state to -1.

name: p11_field_update_animal_fence_alerts
summary: Evaluates outdoor pasture/pet status for area_kind (0: horse + 20 barn livestock in g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl, 1: horse via hm_ovl11_query_pasture_tile_grass, 2: dog g_anim_dog_state via p11_pet_dog_dispatch_state) and clears alert counters g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_fence_count/62/64 when calm.

name: p11_field_dispatch_item_use_effect
summary: Dispatches item_id in range 0xa1..0x165 via jump table g_farm_field_dispatch_item_use_jtbl_ptr to execute item consumption/spawn behavior.

name: p11_field_place_barn_animal_in_pasture
summary: Computes barn stall/pasture position from g_farm_field_place_barn_animal_value_1/30/34 for slot_idx (-1, -2, or 0..19 in rows of 5), writes +0x38..+0x40, sets facing 1 or 3, and sets zone 5.

name: p11_field_place_coop_chicken_in_yard
summary: Computes yard grid coordinates from g_farm_field_place_coop_chicken_value_1/90/94 using slot_idx/5 and slot_idx%5 (400-unit spacing), writes position (+0x38..+0x40), rolls random facing via hm_prng_next(4), and sets zone 4.

name: p11_field_apply_entity_zone_transition
summary: Tests zone transition flags 0x4000000..0x20000000 on entity_rec+0x34, resolves exit coordinates across farm/barn/greenhouse/coop via p11_core_lookup_field_spawn_rect, updates entity position, and clears velocity/lock flag 0x2000.

name: p11_field_init_spawned_animal_flags
summary: Sets bit 0x1000 for wild/forage critters (0x113..0x157) or bit 0x80000000 for cows (0x162, 0x163) in entity status flags at animal_rec+0x34.

name: p11_field_is_tile_or_wall_blocked
summary: Checks raycast obstruction via hm_ovl11_raycast_ground_height when 0x80128d6c equals 1 and otherwise tests ground collision mask 0xc000 via hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection.

name: p11_field_get_season_bitmask
summary: Converts current season g_farm_calendar_clock (0..3) into a 1-hot bitmask (1, 2, 4, or 8).

name: p11_field_update_pickup_sprite_anim
summary: Looks up sprite/palette indices via p11_field_get_critter_spawn_zone_rect for a ground pickup slot, applies any changed sprite state, advances animation via hm_ovl11_spawn_soil_splash_fx, and marks visibility.

name: p11_field_sync_entity_velocity_to_pos
summary: Adds velocity (+0x48) into position (+0x38) with zero Y override via p11_field_integrate_vec3_velocity(entity_rec+0x38, entity_rec+0x48, 0).

name: p11_field_spawn_ground_pickup_item
summary: Finds a free slot among the 6 ground pickup slots at 0x80075bc4, initializes it via p11_field_alloc_and_init_pickup_slot, stamps calendar day/time from 0x80070cf0..0x80070cf4, and configures fish/truffle variants.

name: p11_field_tick_ground_pickup_slot
summary: Updates an active ground pickup slot by running p11_crop_init_world_entity_or_weather_sprite, dispatching its state handler from g_farm_field_tick_ground_pickup_transition_fn_ptr, and expiring non-locked items after 300 ticks.

name: p11_field_transition_world_entity_ai
summary: Runs AI state entry callback from g_farm_field_transition_world_entity_table[next_state], and if g_farm_field_tick_ground_pickup_transition_fn_ptr[next_state] is non-null and entry succeeds, commits next_state (+0x26), resets timers (+0x28..+0x2c), and zeroes velocity via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags.

name: p11_field_set_tool_hit_animal_pair
summary: Records hit animal kind and slot index in g_farm_field_tool_hit_animal_count and g_farm_field_tool_hit_animal_spr_counter.

name: p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot
summary: Zeroes all 0xb0 bytes of a world entity/critter record using memset and clears its leading ID bytes.

name: p11_field_find_outdoor_animal_slot
summary: Thin wrapper invoking p11_field_pick_random_grazing_animal(building_kind) to locate a random active outdoor animal slot index.

name: p11_field_apply_wild_dog_scare_penalty
summary: For wild dog entity (0x15b), when morning outside (p11_core_get_overlay_busy_flag == 1, g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 0x1000000 set, g_farm_cal_hour >= 7), picks a random outdoor animal via p11_field_pick_random_grazing_animal and subtracts 10 affection from g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl_idx0_pos_y_p2/g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl_idx0_name_chars_idx10.

name: p11_field_alloc_and_init_pickup_slot
summary: Zeroes an empty 0xb0-byte ground pickup slot, assigns item_id, initializes its sprite state via p11_field_set_pickup_item_id, and clears its sub-state at +0x54 via p11_ovl_reset_entity_state_pair.

name: p11_field_set_pickup_item_id
summary: Stores item_id into the ground pickup slot header and invokes p11_crop_init_world_entity_or_weather_sprite to initialize its sprite and runtime state.

name: p11_field_get_critter_spawn_zone_rect
summary: Reads packed u16 pair from g_farm_field_critter_spawn_zone_count_1/g_farm_field_critter_spawn_zone_count_2 indexed by (group_idx, entry_idx) into out_val_a and optional out_val_b, returning 0.

name: p11_crop_select_world_entity_ai_state
summary: Dispatches initial AI state by entity type *entity_rec (0x108..0x17b) via p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_a/c54/ca4/ce8/d2c or SystemError('E', 100) on unknown type, then commits state via p11_field_transition_world_entity_ai.

name: p11_crop_init_world_entity_or_weather_sprite
summary: Selects seasonal field foliage/prop sprite table offsets in g_farm_crop_world_entity_weather_value, g_farm_festival_field_vram_sweat_crop_table, or g_cd_sync_upload_area_vram_hud_value by entity_rec[0] (0x108..0x17b) and g_farm_calendar_clock, loads weather sprites 0x28..0x2c via hm_ovl11_load_weather_sprites, or initializes 0x0e anim via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_field_get_entity_walk_speed
summary: Returns base movement speed by entity ID *entity_rec: 0x18 for wild dog (0x15b), 6 for adult/calf cow (0x162/0x165), or 0xc for all other critters/animals.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_a
summary: Rolls 1-in-3 (or 1-in-8 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 8, 9, or 1.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_b
summary: Rolls 1-in-3 (or 1-in-8 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 0xb, 0xc, or 1.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_c
summary: Rolls 1-in-2 (or 1-in-7 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 10 or 1.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_d
summary: Rolls 1-in-2 (or 1-in-7 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 0xd or 1.

name: p11_field_get_wild_dog_initial_ai_state
summary: Returns wild dog AI state 0x13 if hour g_farm_cal_hour < 7 or timer entity_rec+0xac <= 0, else active chase state 0x14.

name: p11_field_pick_random_grazing_animal
summary: Collects active outdoor animals (zone == 1, flags & 0x20400 == 0) from barn g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (is_coop == 0, 20 slots) or coop g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl (10 slots) and returns a random index via hm_prng_next or -1.

name: p11_field_find_nearby_outdoor_animal
summary: Searches barn livestock g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (types 0/1) and chicken coop g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl (type 2) matching zone_id within search_radius of (origin_x, origin_z), returning the slot index or -1.

name: p11_spr_show_animal_or_prop_inspect_msg
summary: Selects dialogue ID (0x261..0x277) from entity type *entity_rec and sub-state entity_rec[0x18] (tracking first-time event flags 0x9e/0x9f and g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_spawn_counter), opens message via hm_dialogue_set_window_state, and returns -1.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_01
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_1 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, sets bit 0x800 during playback, and sets +0x2c = 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_entity_walk_speed
summary: Looks up move speed via p11_field_get_entity_walk_speed, steps entity movement via p11_field_step_entity_path_movement (mask 0x9010 for 0x15b, else 0x8031), sets moving flag at entity_rec[0x12], and clears bit 0x800 of entity_rec+0x34.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_02
summary: Steps action script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_2 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack with random initial timer hm_prng_next(0x3c), dispatches sub-phase via g_gfx_spr_tbl_jtbl_ptr jump table, and despawns via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot when finished.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_03
summary: Steps action script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_3 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, applies speed-12 facing velocity on phase 2 via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, and despawns entity via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot when done.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_04
summary: Steps action script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_4 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, sets active bit 0x800 on start, and despawns entity via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot when phase reaches -1.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_05
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_5 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_06
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_6 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_07
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_7 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_08
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_8 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_09
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_9 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_10
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_10 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_11
summary: Steps action script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_11 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, applies speed-0x3c jump/arc velocity in phases 2 and 3 (adjusting Y velocity -0x10 on phase 2), and despawns via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot when done.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_12
summary: Steps action script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_12 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, applies speed-0x3c jump/arc velocity in phases 2 and 3 (adjusting Y velocity -0x10 on phase 2), and despawns via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot when done.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_13
summary: Steps action script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_13 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, sets speed-0x3c forward velocity on phase 2 via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, and despawns via p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot when done.

name: p11_spr_step_world_anim_slot_14
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table g_gfx_spr_tbl_value_14 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_update_wild_dog_patrol_ai
summary: Runs wild dog predator AI state machine: sets bit 0x1000000 in g_npc_event_progress_flags, initializes spawn/target at (-0x1324, 0, -0x2198) via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters, walks via p11_spr_step_entity_walk_speed, picks outdoor barn/coop target via p11_field_pick_random_grazing_animal, and switches state to 0x13 or 0x14.

name: p11_spr_pursue_outdoor_animal_ai
summary: Scans for an active outdoor barn/coop animal within 800 units via p11_field_find_nearby_outdoor_animal, locks onto its live coordinates via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters, pursues via p11_spr_step_entity_walk_speed, and transitions state to 0x13 if hour < 7 or 7 when bit 0x2000 clears.

name: p11_spr_run_wild_dog_action_script
summary: Executes entity animation/action table 0x80123c94 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, initializes emote/state via p11_ovl_set_entity_state_pair, plays SFX 0x1a when facing 0, and steps movement via p11_field_step_entity_path_movement(entity_rec, 0x18, 0x9010).

name: p11_spr_clear_item_slot_triple
summary: Zeroes the three halfwords (item ID, sub-data, count/flags) of a 6-byte inventory item slot.

name: p11_spr_get_item_display_kind
summary: Reads descriptor flags in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28] and returns 0 if bit 0x4000 is set, 1 if bits 0x8100 are set, or 2 otherwise.

name: p11_spr_get_item_equip_slot_type
summary: Extracts equipment category 0..3 from bits 0x10000000..0x40000000 of g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 0x18].

name: p11_spr_is_item_edible_or_holdable
summary: Returns true when the sign bit (0x80000000) is set on item descriptor dword g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 0x18].

name: p11_spr_get_item_shipping_value_tier
summary: Returns the signed category/tier byte at offset +2 in item descriptor g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28].

name: p11_spr_has_item_flag_0x8100
summary: Returns true when mask 0x8100 is non-zero in the leading flags word of g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28].

name: p11_spr_invoke_item_action_callback
summary: Reads descriptor entry g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_slot[0]*0x28], chooses parameter byte from slot_word_ptr[0x10] or item_slot[1] (if bit 0x800 set), and invokes callback pointer at +0x1c or returns -1.

name: p11_spr_find_tool_pattern_cell_offset
summary: Looks up a 13x13 tool area pattern in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr/g_gfx_spr_find_tool_pattern_diary_lut32, rotates it by facing_dir via p11_spr_rotate_13x13_tool_pattern, and outputs relative tile offsets (out_dx, out_dz) for step_index + 1.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_max_growth_stage
summary: Looks up crop growth index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns mature stage count from g_gfx_grid_collision_spr_crop_lut32[idx*0x10 + 2], or -1 if invalid.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_regrow_stage
summary: Looks up crop growth index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns post-harvest regrow stage at g_gfx_grid_collision_spr_crop_lut32[idx*0x10 + 4], or -1 if non-regrowing.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_harvest_item_id
summary: Looks up crop growth index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns harvested produce item ID at g_gfx_grid_collision_spr_crop_lut32[idx*0x10 + 0xe], or 0.

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x8000
summary: Looks up sub-entry index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] into g_gfx_grid_collision_tile_spr_cfg and tests flag bit 0x8000.

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x2000
summary: Looks up sub-entry index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] into g_gfx_grid_collision_tile_spr_cfg and tests flag bit 0x2000.

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x4000
summary: Looks up sub-entry index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] into g_gfx_grid_collision_tile_spr_cfg and tests flag bit 0x4000.

name: p11_spr_get_sub_entry_u16_0_if_flagged
summary: Reads 8-byte entry in g_gfx_grid_collision_tile_spr_cfg referenced by g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] and returns halfword 0 when mask 0xe000 is non-zero, or -1.

name: p11_spr_get_sub_entry_u16_2_if_flagged
summary: Reads 8-byte entry in g_gfx_grid_collision_tile_spr_cfg referenced by g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] and returns halfword +2 when mask 0xe000 is non-zero, or -1.

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x800
summary: Looks up sub-entry index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] into g_gfx_grid_collision_tile_spr_cfg and tests flag bit 0x800.

name: p11_spr_get_item_sell_price
summary: Returns shipping price at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[(item_id&0xffff)*0x28 + 0x12], adding +10 bonus for item 0x97 (Apple/Honey event bit 0x400000 in g_npc_event_progress_flags).

name: p11_spr_is_item_shippable_flag
summary: Checks descriptor flags word (*desc & 0x8100 == 0x8000) and sub-byte != 1 in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr for item_id.

name: p11_spr_get_recipe_dish_sub_id
summary: Returns item_slot[1] when item_slot[0] == 0xa4 (cooked/custom dish variant), otherwise 0.

name: p11_spr_get_npc_gift_reaction
summary: Decodes 3-bit NPC gift preference tier from packed table g_ovl15_spr_gift_reaction_diary_deserialize_state indexed by descriptor gift group g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[item_id*0x28 + 0xe] and npc_id, adjusting tiers <5 when bits 0x180 are set.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_base_seed_id
summary: Looks up crop growth index at g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns first u16 in g_gfx_grid_collision_spr_crop_lut32[idx*0x10], or -1 if invalid.

name: p11_spr_apply_stamina_fatigue_happiness
summary: Clamps and applies deltas to player stamina g_core_player_state_stamina, fatigue g_core_player_state_pad_0x16 (0..100, capped at 99 at 6:00 when g_farm_cal_hour == 6), and g_core_player_state_tool_exp_and_timers_idx15, returning 1.

name: p11_spr_query_villager_heart_to_out
summary: Reads villager affection/heart level via hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level(npc_id, sub_idx), writes it to *out_hearts if non-null, and returns 1.

name: p11_spr_rotate_13x13_tool_pattern
summary: Copies or rotates a 13x13 byte pattern grid from src_grid into out_grid according to facing_dir (0, 1, 2, or 3).

name: p11_spr_reset_vram_pack_tables
summary: Zeroes the 0x24-byte pack slot header and fills the 0x21c-byte tile descriptor cache with 0xff via memset.

name: p11_spr_alloc_model_pack_slot
summary: Finds a zero entry in the 9-slot table g_gfx_clear_render_entity_slot_spr_table_alloc_model + bank_idx*9, stores item_id, and returns the slot index or -1.

name: p11_spr_are_all_pack_tpages_low
summary: Scans 9 sprite pack entries in g_gfx_clear_render_entity_slot_spr_table_are_all + bank_idx*0x10e (stride 0x1e) and returns 0 if any active entry has VRAM X (+0x18) >= 0x3f0, else 1.

name: p11_spr_find_free_pack_vram_row
summary: Finds the first unused slot row 0..7 in g_gfx_clear_render_entity_slot_spr_table_are_all + bank_idx*0x10e where *entry != row*8 or entry[0xc] >= 0x3f0.

name: p11_spr_find_area_prop_sprite_data
summary: Looks up area pack index *(g_core_event_script_ctx+10), scans g_gfx_spr_find_area_prop_dat_ptr/g_cd_copy_actor_pack_spr_sprite_dat_ptr for prop_id, and returns &g_gfx_spr_find_area_prop_pack_table + offset or NULL.

name: p11_spr_upload_pack_frames_to_vram
summary: Uploads pair_count texture and 16x1 CLUT RECT slices from pack_desc frame table into VRAM at (tex_x, tex_y) and (clut_x, clut_y) via MoveImage.

name: p11_spr_submit_pack_sprt_primitive
summary: Builds a SPRT + DR_MODE primitive pair from g_gfx_clear_render_entity_slot_spr_table_are_all[bank_idx, slot_idx], links both into ot_head via AddPrim, and returns advanced prim_buf + 0x20.

name: p11_spr_add_item_slot_quantity
summary: Adds delta_qty to item_slot+4, clamps negative values to 0xffff, and returns 1 if the resulting quantity is 0.

name: p11_spr_zero_item_slot_6b
summary: Clears all three 16-bit fields of a 6-byte inventory item slot to zero.

name: p11_spr_set_item_slot_6b
summary: Populates a 6-byte item slot with item_id, sub_val, and count_val.

name: p11_spr_copy_item_slot_6b
summary: Copies three consecutive halfwords (6 bytes) from src_slot into dst_slot.

name: p11_spr_classify_held_item_action
summary: Classifies held item ID *item_slot using g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr descriptor bits (0x400 -> 4, 0x1800 -> 3, 0x40 -> 1, 0x100 -> 0) and special item IDs (0x3a..0x65 -> 5, default -> 2).

name: p11_spr_get_special_item_stamina_heal
summary: Returns stamina/recovery bonus for special forage/herb/medicine item IDs (0x5c, 0x60, 0x67, 0x97, 0x9c, 0x9e, 0xf7..0xf9, 0x185), or 0.

name: p11_spr_is_item_livestock_fodder
summary: Returns 1 if item_id is livestock fodder, lumber, or golden lumber (0x122..0x124, 0xe8, or 0x125), else 0.

name: p11_spr_is_item_pet_feed
summary: Returns 1 if item_id is dog/pet feed (0x8b..0x8d or 0xe3), else 0.

name: p11_spr_is_item_chicken_feed
summary: Returns 1 if item_id is chicken feed (0x91..0x93 or 0xe7), else 0.

name: p11_spr_noop_outdoor_tile_mesh_stub
summary: No-op outdoor tile mesh updater whose branches were stripped during optimization; returns 0.

name: p11_spr_rebuild_all_outdoor_field_meshes
summary: Iterates all 45x25 tiles in g_farm_field_grid, maps soil state (0x167..0x16b) or grass tile 0x36 connectivity mask to mesh variant ID, and updates tile visuals via p11_spr_noop_outdoor_tile_mesh_stub.

name: p11_gfx_cache_field_tile_pointers
summary: Scans the 45x25 outdoor farm field grid in world coordinates (-0x1068..+X, 0x5dc..-Z, step 400), probing collision flags via hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection and caching matching cell pointers in 0x8009e5f8.

name: p11_spr_reset_greenhouse_field_grid
summary: Initializes all 7x7 tiles of g_farm_greenhouse_grid (greenhouse grid) to empty soil 0x167 with zero growth/water bytes.

name: p11_spr_is_tile_blocked_or_oob
summary: Checks tile bounds (tile_x, tile_z) against g_gfx_spr_tile_blocked_oob_count_1/g_gfx_spr_tile_blocked_oob_count_2 and tests tile collision bit 8 in g_farm_cache_field_tile_pointers_spr_value when require_tillable != 0; returns 1 if blocked.

name: p11_spr_tile_coords_to_world_pos
summary: Converts outdoor field (is_greenhouse == 0) or greenhouse 7x7 grid indices (tile_x, tile_z) at 400-unit spacing into world XZ coordinates in out_pos.

name: p11_spr_plant_seed_on_tilled_tile
summary: Plants seed_item_id onto tilled soil (0x168/0x169) returned by hm_ovl11_set_actor_facing_vec, rolls 1/25 chance for special flower 0x179 vs 0x178 on seed 0x33, clears stage bytes, and updates mesh via g_gfx_spr_plant_seed_tilled_water_fn_ptr.

name: p11_spr_water_field_or_greenhouse_tile
summary: Marks tilled soil (0x168 -> 0x169, 0x16a -> 0x16b) as watered on non-winter or indoor tiles via hm_ovl11_set_actor_facing_vec and updates tile appearance through g_gfx_spr_plant_seed_tilled_water_fn_ptr.

name: p11_spr_till_field_plot_tile
summary: Validates tillability via p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x800 on outdoor/greenhouse farm plots, sets soil state (0x168 dry or 0x169 watered in rain), rolls item drop via p11_field_roll_spawn_bug_or_forage_drop, and updates crop tile mesh.

name: p11_spr_harvest_crop_from_tile
summary: Validates harvestable mature crop on tile_ptr via hm_ovl11_is_entity_slot_active/89c/c3c, advances regrowing crops via p11_spr_get_crop_regrow_stage or resets tile to base soil, and maps flower IDs 0x3a..0x40 to 0x13a..0x13d by season g_farm_calendar_clock.

name: p11_spr_sickle_cut_field_tile
summary: Checks cuttable field contents via p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x8000, harvests fodder grass (0x36 -> p11_evt_add_chicken_feed_count) or clears weeds/dead crops via p11_spr_spawn_grid_tile_effect and p11_spr_cut_single_grass_tile, and rolls forage drop via p11_field_roll_spawn_bug_or_forage_drop.

name: p11_spr_harvest_or_cut_field_tile
summary: Checks tool tier and charge requirements on a farm field cell (rocks, boulders, stumps, logs, branches, grass) and clears multi-tile obstacles via p11_spr_clear_field_tile_to_soil and p11_spr_spawn_grid_tile_effect while awarding wood.

name: p11_spr_mark_all_field_tiles_dirty
summary: Iterates all 45x25 tiles in g_farm_field_grid (row stride 0xb4, tile stride 8) and sets bit 0x10 (rain/watered) or 0x20 (clear) on every tile via p11_spr_try_wilt_blue_magic_flower.

name: p11_spr_reset_all_field_tile_flags
summary: Sweeps all 45x25 tiles in g_farm_field_grid and clears render/growth/water state flags via p11_spr_try_wither_crop_tile_by_chance(..., 0x10), p11_spr_try_wither_grown_grass_tile(..., 8), and p11_spr_try_wilt_blue_magic_flower(..., 0x10).

name: p11_spr_compute_visible_field_tile_bounds
summary: Projects a +/-0xe10 window around camera/spawn anchor (g_core_spawn_pos_x, g_core_spawn_pos_z) into clamped [0..0x2d] x [0..0x19] field tile bounds.

name: p11_spr_render_outdoor_field_crops
summary: Computes visible field bounds via p11_spr_compute_visible_field_tile_bounds, dispatches seasonal crop sprite mapper (seasonal crop sprite mappers (spring/summer/autumn/winter)) over g_farm_field_grid tiles, projects each tile via hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos, and submits crop quads via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad.

name: p11_spr_map_spring_crop_tile_sprite
summary: Maps Spring crop/flower/forage IDs (0x22..0x34, 0x3a..0x64, 0x16d..0x175) and growth_stage to sprite index, flags, and vertical offset via p11_spr_emit_crop_sprite_if_grown.

name: p11_spr_map_summer_crop_tile_sprite
summary: Maps Summer crop/flower/forage IDs (0x22..0x35, 0x3a..0x40, 0x16d..0x175) and growth_stage to sprite index, flags, and vertical offset via p11_spr_emit_crop_sprite_if_grown.

name: p11_spr_map_fall_crop_tile_sprite
summary: Maps Fall crop/flower/forage IDs (0x27..0x35, 0x3a..0x40, 0x16d..0x179) and growth_stage to sprite index, flags, and vertical offset via p11_spr_emit_crop_sprite_if_grown.

name: p11_spr_emit_crop_sprite_if_grown
summary: If growth_stage != 0, writes flags_val and sprite_id into out_flags and out_sprite_id and returns 1, else returns 0.

name: p11_spr_render_greenhouse_crops
summary: Iterates over the 7x7 greenhouse grid g_farm_greenhouse_grid, projects each tile via hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos, maps crop IDs (0x22..0x3f, 0x175..0x179) and growth byte g_farm_greenhouse_grid_idx4 via p11_spr_emit_crop_sprite_if_grown, and submits quads to g_gfx_active_disp_ctx_ptr via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad.

name: p11_spr_clear_field_tile_to_soil
summary: Resets a field or greenhouse 8-byte tile record to empty base soil 0x167 with zero stage/water flags.

name: p11_spr_try_spawn_bamboo_or_flower_tile
summary: Checks season g_farm_calendar_clock (Spring 1/128, Summer 1/64, Fall 1/128) and if tile_ptr[0] is empty soil (0x167..0x169), rolls hm_prng_next to spawn forage item 0x40 on the tile.

name: p11_spr_try_wilt_blue_magic_flower
summary: If tile_ptr[0] is flower 0x3f and chance_denom != 0, rolls hm_prng_next(chance_denom & 0xffff) and converts it to rare variant 0x175 on 0.

name: p11_spr_try_wither_crop_tile_by_chance
summary: If tile_ptr[0] is an active non-grass crop via hm_ovl11_is_entity_slot_active and hm_prng_next(chance_denom) == 0, clears the crop back to tilled tile 0x168.

name: p11_spr_try_wither_grown_grass_tile
summary: If tile_ptr[0] is grown grass (0x36 with non-zero stage) and hm_prng_next(chance_denom) == 0, regresses its stage via p11_spr_get_crop_regrow_stage(0x36) and sets bit 0x8000 on tile_ptr[3].

name: p11_spr_init_pack_sprite_anims
summary: Reads sprite frame count (clamped to 0x2c) from g_cd_copy_actor_pack_spr_sprite_dat_ptr[pack_idx] and initializes consecutive 0x30-byte slots in g_gfx_spr_render_outdoor_field_greenhouse_table from g_gfx_spr_find_area_prop_pack_table offsets via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_spr_update_grass_autotile_neighborhood
summary: Evaluates 3x3 grass (0x36) bitmasks across the 9 neighboring tiles around (tile_x, tile_z) using g_gfx_spr_grass_autotile_neighborhood_value and hm_ovl11_set_actor_facing_vec, computes autotile variants 0..7, and updates meshes via g_gfx_spr_plant_seed_tilled_water_fn_ptr.

name: p11_spr_spawn_grid_tile_effect
summary: Converts outdoor field (is_greenhouse == 0) or greenhouse (7x7) tile coordinates (grid_x, grid_z) into world space and spawns effect_id via p11_ovl_spawn_seasonal_fx_sprite.

name: p11_spr_cut_single_grass_tile
summary: Cuts grown grass tile 0x36 at (tile_x, tile_z) by resetting growth byte via p11_spr_get_crop_regrow_stage(0x36), setting bit 0x8000 on tile[3], and refreshing the tile mesh via g_gfx_spr_plant_seed_tilled_water_fn_ptr.

name: p11_spr_count_or_find_matching_tiles
summary: Scans g_farm_field_grid (45x25) or greenhouse g_farm_greenhouse_grid (7x7) from a random start via hm_prng_next matching crop ID, soil ID, and stage byte per wildcard mask match_flags (bits 0..2), returning first or total count (bit 3).

name: p11_spr_dry_watered_field_tile
summary: Reverts watered soil states (0x169 -> 0x168, 0x16b -> 0x16a) overnight on an 8-byte field tile record.

name: p11_spr_init_default_camera_bounds
summary: Resets player/camera XZ clamp bounds g_gfx_spr_default_camera_bounds_clamp_counter_pos..g_gfx_spr_default_camera_bounds_clamp_state_1 to the default outdoor farm perimeter.

name: p11_spr_set_camera_clamp_bounds
summary: Copies min_vec[0..2] and max_vec[0..2] into world camera/entity boundary globals g_gfx_spr_default_camera_bounds_clamp_counter_pos..g_gfx_spr_default_camera_bounds_clamp_state_1.

name: p11_spr_clamp_pos_to_camera_bounds
summary: Clamps pos_vec[0] (X) and pos_vec[2] (Z) against active bounding box g_gfx_spr_default_camera_bounds_clamp_counter_pos..g_gfx_spr_default_camera_bounds_clamp_state_1.

name: p11_spr_reset_vram_anim_slots
summary: Zeroes the 0xb4-byte VRAM scroll/anim table and marks all 8 slot IDs starting at g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 (stride 0x16) as unused (0xffff).

name: p11_spr_register_vram_anim_slot
summary: Avoids duplicate IDs in g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 (8 slots stride 0x16), finds an unused (-1) slot, zeroes it via memset, and copies VRAM RECT/frame fields from slot_desc.

name: p11_spr_free_vram_anim_slot
summary: Checks g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 for matching slot_id, clears its 0x16 bytes via memset, and resets its ID to 0xffff.

name: p11_spr_load_zone_tile_vram_overlays
summary: Iterates up to 8 VRAM/tile animation descriptors at script_ctx+0x8a8 (stride 0x12) when zone != 0xf or weather g_farm_current_weather is storm/snow, dispatching active entries (!= -1) to p11_spr_register_vram_anim_slot.

name: p11_spr_step_vram_moveimage_slot
summary: Uploads the current VRAM RECT via MoveImage unless suppressed by zone 0x5b without event flag 0x45, increments frame counter (+10), and loads the next frame descriptor from g_core_event_script_ctx+0x8a8.

name: p11_spr_step_vram_scroll_slot
summary: Uploads split wrapped texture strips in VRAM via MoveImage for vertical water/waterfall scroll animation and advances offset (+10) by 2 pixels when timer (+0xc) reaches +8.

name: p11_spr_tick_world_prop_sprite_slots
summary: Loops over 8 world prop slots at g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx11 (stride 0x16) when g_core_engine_flags0 pause bit 0x8000000 is clear, dispatching active slots (!= 0xffff) to p11_spr_step_vram_scroll_slot or p11_spr_step_vram_moveimage_slot (if bit 0x8000 set).

name: p11_gfx_update_camera_offset_gte
summary: Rotates camera distance g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars by yaw g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx3 around g_gfx_camera_offset_gte_render_compute_state_livestock_models matrix via GTE PushMatrix/RotMatrix/RotTrans/PopMatrix into g_gfx_cam_offset_x..a0.

name: p11_gfx_apply_camera_look_at_and_target
summary: Updates camera eye position (g_gfx_cam_offset_x/9e/a0 + spawn g_core_spawn_pos_x/a8) via gfx_cam_set_eye and camera target position g_core_spawn_pos_x/a6/a8 via gfx_cam_set_target.

name: p11_gfx_reset_camera_rig_params
summary: Sets default camera orbit distance (-0x2328), pitch/height (-0x1194), and yaw (-0x200) globals g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars..g_core_event_script_ctx_script_work_vars_idx4.

name: p11_gfx_init_three_point_lighting
summary: Configures 3 PS1 SDK flat lights (g_gfx_three_point_lighting_value_1/c8/d8) via GsSetFlatLight, sets ambient light (0x800, 0x800, 0x800) via GsSetAmbient, and enables light mode 0 via GsSetLightMode.

name: p11_gfx_step_particle_and_debris_pools
summary: Steps particle/effect update pools gfx_sdk_set_geom_screen_wrap(1000) and gfx_sdk_set_geom_screen(1000) once per frame.

name: p11_gfx_draw_player_camera_rig
summary: Adds camera offsets g_gfx_cam_offset_x/9e/a0 to spawn anchor g_core_spawn_pos_x/a6/a8 into a local camera vector pair and draws g_gfx_camera_projection_player_setup_value via hm_gte_draw_animated_model.

name: p11_gfx_zero_camera_offsets_and_spawn
summary: Zeroes camera offset and target anchor globals g_gfx_cam_offset_x..g_core_spawn_pos_z.

name: p11_gfx_reset_hud_and_villager_timers
summary: Zeroes g_anim_shipping_pet_state and resets 5 HUD prompt slots, clears g_npc_active_cutscene_actor_ptr, fills 0x80-byte + 8-byte timer blocks at g_gfx_hud_villager_timers_flag_4/aeff with 0xff, zeroes g_gfx_hud_villager_timers_flag_6, and sets default icon timers at g_gfx_hud_villager_timers_execute_flag..aea4.

name: p11_gfx_is_hud_prompt_queued
summary: Scans the 5 HUD prompt slots starting at g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx4 (stride 0xc) for active entry matching prompt_id, returning 1 if found.

name: p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_default
summary: Invokes p11_gfx_alloc_hud_prompt_slot(prompt_id, 0, 0) to trigger a default HUD/screen prompt banner.

name: p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_mode1
summary: Invokes p11_gfx_alloc_hud_prompt_slot(prompt_id, 1, 0) to trigger a mode-1 HUD/screen prompt banner.

name: p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_mode2
summary: Invokes p11_gfx_alloc_hud_prompt_slot(prompt_id, 0, 1) to trigger a mode-2 HUD/screen prompt banner.

name: p11_gfx_tick_affection_and_weather_cutscene_timers
summary: Increments byte counters in g_ovl15_tick_affection_weather_cutscene_diary_flag..8007aef8 capped at 0x78 when active, checks festival status via hm_ovl11_grid_tile_to_world, and steps cutscene triggers via hm_ovl11_trigger_cutscene_script while updating g_gfx_tick_affection_weather_cutscene_dbg_value on storm/snow weather.

name: p11_gfx_alloc_hud_prompt_slot
summary: Optionally checks p11_gfx_is_hud_prompt_queued, then scans 1 or 5 12-byte slots starting at g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx4 for a free (-1) entry, zeroes its fields, and returns its pointer.

name: p11_gfx_step_scene_animation_handler
summary: Invokes handler g_gfx_scene_animation_handler_fn_ptr[anim_index](), sets event flag 2 while running (!= 1), or clears flag 2, zeroes g_anim_shipping_pet_state, and calls p11_gfx_pop_hud_prompt_queue on completion.

name: p11_gfx_pop_hud_prompt_queue
summary: Shifts the 5-slot HUD prompt queue starting at g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx4 down by one 12-byte entry and marks tail slot g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx52 as 0xffff.

name: p11_gfx_finish_cutscene_actor_anim
summary: Checks whether g_npc_active_cutscene_actor_ptr+4 is non-zero; when true clears event flag 2 via hm_event_flag_set, zeroes g_anim_shipping_pet_state, and invokes p11_gfx_pop_hud_prompt_queue.

name: p11_gfx_has_queued_hud_prompts
summary: Checks HUD prompt queue slots 1..4 starting at g_anim_shipping_pet_state_idx16 and returns 1 if any slot != -1.

name: p11_gfx_clear_active_event_trigger
summary: Zeroes g_core_event_script_ctx_active_trigger active trigger pointer and resets g_core_event_script_ctx_transition_args and g_core_event_script_ctx_transition_args_idx1 to 0xffff.

name: p11_gfx_reset_world_sprite_pool
summary: Calls hm_res_gfx_reset_world_spr(200) to reset world sprite rendering buffers.
