name: p11_gfx_setup_map_lighting_and_weather
summary: Copies active map lighting parameters into 0x800a0368, triggers map palette/resource setup, updates time-of-day fog/tint, and dispatches extra tile handlers for field (0xf) or barn (0x2c) maps.

name: p11_field_complete_animal_feed_or_emote_action
summary: Clears active animal emote/status via p11_evt_record_shipped_item(animal_rec+0xb6), plays SFX 0x13 and sets event flag 7 if animal_rec+0x30 == 0, clears +0xb6 and +0xdc, and returns 1.

name: p11_field_get_animal_waypoint_pos
summary: Looks up indoor/outdoor animal waypoint coordinates from g_farm_field_animal_waypoint_pos_region..80127e40 by waypoint_kind (0..5) and barn/coop upgrade flags g_farm_upgrade_flags0/0a, writing matching XYZ to out_pos.

name: p11_field_check_feed_trough_collision
summary: Offsets the animal's position by facing radius via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, probes collision mask 0x8026 via p11_core_probe_actor_ray_unbounded, and if flag 0x20 hits inspects the tile via p11_spr_harvest_crop_from_tile.

name: p11_field_clear_animal_landing_tile
summary: Projects a 100-unit forward offset along animal heading animal_rec+0x22 via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, converts to tile via hm_ovl11_interp_entity_heading or p11_ui_world_pos_to_7x7_grid, and clears tile via p11_spr_water_field_or_greenhouse_tile.

name: p11_field_wait_animal_zone_dwell
summary: Tracks dwell ticks at animal_rec+0x2a while state +0x24 == target_state and returns 1 once min_ticks elapse and +0x30 or flags +0x7a & 0x300 are non-zero.

name: p11_field_is_animal_in_barn_zone
summary: Checks whether animal_rec is positioned inside barn/target zone 5 via p11_field_wait_animal_zone_dwell(animal_rec, 5, 0) and returns true if non-zero.

name: p11_field_step_animal_to_slot
summary: Sets animal target slot via p11_field_set_seek_arrival_radius, steps movement via p11_animl_sprite_step_move_collision, preserves bit 0x800 on animal_rec+0x34, and clears velocity via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags(4, animal_rec+0x48, 0) upon arrival when flag 0x2000 clears.

name: p11_field_get_animal_target_cell_center
summary: Resolves a pasture/barn/coop grid slot via p11_field_find_random_matching_field_tile, converts its tile coordinates to world position via p11_spr_tile_coords_to_world_pos, and writes the coordinates via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters.

name: p11_field_find_random_matching_field_tile
summary: Starts at a random tile via hm_prng_next in g_farm_field_grid (45x25) or greenhouse g_farm_greenhouse_grid (7x7) and scans wraparound using predicate p11_field_is_tile_active_crop_stage/p11_field_is_tile_tall_grass/p11_field_is_tile_weed_or_grass, returning tile coordinates on match (0) or 1 if none found.

name: p11_field_is_tile_active_crop_stage
summary: Checks tile via p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop, excludes grass/special ranges (0x31..0x35, 0x178..0x179), and returns 1 when the tile growth byte matches its max stage descriptor in g_gfx_sprite_desc_tbl_ptr/g_gfx_grid_collision_spr_crop_lut32.

name: p11_field_is_tile_tall_grass
summary: Checks tile via p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop and returns 1 if the secondary tile ID at tile_ptr+2 is 0x168 or 0x16a (cuttable grass/weed).

name: p11_field_is_tile_weed_or_grass
summary: Checks tile via p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop and returns 1 if the secondary tile ID at tile_ptr+2 is 0x168, 0x169, 0x16a, or 0x16b.

name: p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop
summary: Verifies *tile_ptr is an active crop via hm_ovl11_is_entity_slot_active and returns true when *tile_ptr is not grass (0x36).

name: p11_field_pick_random_eligible_animal
summary: Scans chicken coop g_anim_chicken_coop_tbl or barn livestock g_anim_livestock_barn_tbl (plus pregnant/special slots g_farm_field_all_animal_pickup_sync_cfg16/6206 and NPC actor jobs) matching target_zone and filter_flags (fed/produce/sick), returning a random index via hm_prng_next.

name: p11_field_get_barn_stall_pos
summary: Computes indoor barn stall XYZ coordinates from g_farm_field_barn_stall_pos_value_1/64/68 for livestock slot_idx (0..0x15, including pregnant slots 0x14/0x15).

name: p11_field_get_coop_perch_pos
summary: Computes coop perch XYZ coordinates from g_farm_field_coop_perch_pos_value_1/c4/c8 at 400-unit X spacing for chicken slot_idx.

name: p11_field_clear_animal_bubble_state
summary: Resets animal emote bubble ID (+0xb6) and timer pointer (+0xdc) in animal_rec to zero.

name: p11_field_place_sprite_in_farm_work_zone
summary: Reads Harvest Sprite spawn XYZ and facing from g_farm_field_place_sprite_work_value_1..ec using sprite ID sprite_actor+0xac, writes +0x38..+0x40 and +0x22, and sets zone +0x30 = 0x28.

name: p11_field_get_harvest_sprite_task_speed
summary: Computes Harvest Sprite task animation/move speed from season g_farm_calendar_clock/day, active chore (+0x26, +0xb8), skill levels (+0xae..+0xb2), and individual modifier g_farm_field_harvest_sprite_task_value.

name: p11_field_get_harvest_sprite_skill_delay
summary: Selects chore skill (+0xae, +0xb0, +0xb2) by Harvest Sprite task state (+0x26 == 8..10) and returns 2 * g_farm_field_harvest_sprite_skill_dbg_count[skill / 0x34] (or 0x18).

name: p11_field_reset_animal_bubble_when_idle
summary: Clears active animal speech/emote timer pointer at animal_rec+0xdc when bubble ID +0xb6 is 0 or when both +0xdc and animal_rec+0x30 are 0 (also zeroing +0xb6).

name: p11_field_dispatch_animal_feed_item
summary: Dispatches item_id in range 0x41..0x124 through jump table g_farm_field_dispatch_animal_feed_jtbl_ptr to handle animal/NPC item gift response, returning -1 if out of range.

name: p11_field_map_treat_item_to_index
summary: Maps specific animal treat/feed/supply item IDs (0x68..0x124) to compact handler indices 0..15, or -1 if unmatched.

name: p11_field_init_sky_daylight_palette
summary: Resets g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_state to 0, computes sunset hour via p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour and day phase via p11_field_get_daylight_phase, and submits initial sky palette gradient to g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_1/g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_2 via gfx_draw_vram_rect_sync.

name: p11_field_update_sky_daylight_palette
summary: Queries sunset hour via p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour(g_farm_calendar_clock) and day phase via p11_field_get_daylight_phase, driving sky tint interpolation in g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_1/g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_value_2/g_farm_field_sky_daylight_palette_state via gfx_draw_vram_rect_sync, gfx_queue_vram_clut_upload, and gfx_queue_vram_pix_upload.

name: p11_field_get_daylight_phase
summary: Classifies hour against dawn (5..6) and sunset_hour into daylight phase (0: dawn, 1: day, 2: dusk, 3: night).

name: p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour
summary: Returns sunset hour for the given season index from table g_farm_field_season_sunset_hour_value.

name: p11_field_init_daylight_tint_default
summary: Resets g_farm_field_daylight_tint_default_fade_state to 0 and writes initial ambient RGB triple (0xcf7e, 0x105b, 0x166b) via p11_animl_set_fade_palette_a(0, rgb).

name: p11_field_step_daylight_tint_fade
summary: While event flag 8 is 1, interpolates ambient RGB between g_farm_field_daylight_tint_fade_value_1 and g_farm_field_daylight_tint_fade_value_2 over 0x4b0 steps via hm_clut_lerp_rgb_triple, applies it via p11_animl_set_fade_palette_a, and clears flag 8 when done.

name: p11_field_init_upgrade_and_memo_state
summary: Refreshes memo flags via p11_field_sync_memo_hint_flags_wrapper and zeroes carpenter/upgrade timers g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_grant_counter, g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter, and g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_mark_counter during scene initialization.

name: p11_field_grant_cooking_or_tv_item_gift
summary: Classifies gifted item_id (0x13f..0x141 -> 4, 0xf7..0xf9 or 1..0x19 -> 2) into g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_grant_counter, stores item_id in g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter, and sets event flag 0x37 via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_mark_tv_recipe_watched
summary: Sets TV/cooking state flag g_farm_field_upgrade_memo_state_mark_counter to 3.

name: p11_field_sync_memo_hint_flags_wrapper
summary: Wrapper that delegates directly to p11_field_refresh_all_memo_hint_flags to recompute all memo and farm tip bitmask flags.

name: p11_field_refresh_all_memo_hint_flags
summary: Refreshes all 12 bitmask flags in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags covering tools, animals, crops, farm upgrades, sprites, and town NPC tips.

name: p11_field_tick_carpenter_upgrade_timer
summary: Decrements daily construction and countdown timers (0x80070d12, 0x80070d10, 0x800719fc) and completes Gotz farm building upgrades (coop, barn, house 1/2, greenhouse) when timers expire.

name: p11_field_consume_pending_unlock_notice
summary: Queries or consumes the pending farm upgrade/building completion code in g_farm_find_tool_sprite_rank_matches_counter (modes 0, 1, 2), applying coop/barn upgrades 0x13f..0x141 and refreshing memo flags.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit2_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 2 (0x4) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in g_farm_field_refresh_recipe_bit2_value have affection > 100 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count, and sets bit 2 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit3_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 3 (0x8) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in g_farm_field_refresh_recipe_bit3_value have affection > 100 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count, and sets bit 3 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit4_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 4 (0x10) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in g_farm_field_refresh_recipe_bit4_value have affection > 100 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count, and sets bit 4 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit0_from_npc5d
summary: Clears bit 0 (0x1) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags and sets it if NPC 0x5d has affection > 0x32 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count(0x5d).

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit1_from_npc5f
summary: Clears bit 1 (0x2) in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags and sets it if NPC 0x5f has affection > 0x32 via p11_evt_get_shipped_item_count(0x5f).

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_5_to_7
summary: Updates recipe/memo hint bits 0x20, 0x40, and 0x80 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags from g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 0x800, equipped tool g_player_equipped_tool, and g_farm_field_tick_carpenter_upgrade_refresh_counter.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit8_high_affection
summary: Clears bit 0x100 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags, then sets it when g_npc_event_progress_flags bit 0x200000 is clear and any NPC in g_npc_actor_tbl_base (37 entries stride 0x1d4) has affection > 50000.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_9_to_13
summary: Sets milestone memo bits 0x200..0x2000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags for the earliest missing upgrade among coop, house 1, barn, house 2, and greenhouse (g_farm_weather_festival..0c).

name: p11_field_update_goddess_memo_flag
summary: Clears bit 0x4000 of g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags and sets it when hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection(0x1e, 0, 2, 0) indicates the Harvest Goddess gift condition is unmet.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_15_to_17
summary: Sets memo bits 0x8000, 0x10000, or 0x20000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags based on coop/barn upgrades (g_farm_upgrade_flags0/0a) and progress flags g_npc_event_progress_flags (0x100, 0x200, 0x100000).

name: p11_field_update_town_npc_memo_flags
summary: Updates bits 0x40000, 0x80000, and 0x100000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags by querying hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection for NPCs 0x1c, 0x1a, and 0x1b.

name: p11_field_update_sprite_memo_flags
summary: Updates bits 0x200000 and 0x400000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags by querying hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection for NPCs 0x1f and 0x20.

name: p11_field_reset_family_milestone_state
summary: Clears g_farm_field_family_milestone_state_record_counter, sets g_farm_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_counter to 0xffff, and sets event flag 0x1b via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_record_marriage_spouse
summary: Maps bachelorette spouse_npc_id (3, 7, 9, 0xe) to index 0..4 in g_farm_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_counter, saves spouse ID in g_core_calendar_event_flags_daily_scene_counter, zeroes g_farm_field_family_milestone_state_record_counter, and latches wedding date into g_npc_evt_pet_horse_naming_field_cfg..afd4.

name: p11_field_record_wedding_anniversary_date
summary: Saves current day g_farm_cal_day and season g_farm_calendar_clock into g_core_calendar_event_flags_execute_field_cfg16/g_core_calendar_event_flags_execute_field_count, clears pregnancy flag 0x4e via hm_event_flag_set, and resets g_farm_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_counter to 0.

name: p11_field_update_spouse_daily_chores
summary: When marriage event flag 0x41 is set via hm_event_flag_get, selects spouse actor g_npc_actor_tbl_base + g_core_calendar_event_flags_daily_scene_counter*0x1d4, calls p11_field_track_spouse_talk_neglect_days/ab4/c98, and if flag 0x4f is set updates baby via p11_field_update_baby_growth_stage(&g_farm_field_spouse_daily_chores_value).

name: p11_field_get_spouse_profile_ptr
summary: Returns pointer from g_farm_field_spouse_profile_dat_ptr indexed by active spouse slot g_farm_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_counter.

name: p11_field_advance_spouse_pregnancy_timer
summary: When baby born flag 0x4f is clear, advances days-married counter g_farm_field_advance_spouse_pregnancy_cfg16 up to 0x1e, then sets pregnancy flag 0x4e once spouse affection (+4) >= 65000 and advances g_farm_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_counter.

name: p11_field_update_baby_growth_stage
summary: Increments baby age g_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_cfg16_baby_growth up to 300 and updates growth stage g_core_sync_upload_area_vram_weather_state and event flags 0x50 (infant < 60), 0x51 (crawling < 120), and 0x52 (toddler).

name: p11_field_track_spouse_talk_neglect_days
summary: Increments g_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_counter when daily spouse talk flag 0x4b is 0 (resets to 0 if spoken), then clears daily spouse flags 0x4b and 0x4c via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_check_spouse_low_affection_sick
summary: If spouse affection (+4) drops below 0x3a99 and event flag 0x2b is clear, sets flags 0x4d and 0xaf via hm_event_flag_set and increments g_ovl11_execute_story_cutscene_table_field_cfg16_spouse_low up to 3.

name: p11_field_reset_all_mine_floors
summary: Clears all 10 floors (10x10 bytes each) of mine state in g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_trigger_table and reset flags g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_dig_flag.., then zeroes g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_state and floor counter g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter.

name: p11_field_check_player_on_mine_stairs
summary: Maps player coordinates to a 10x10 mine cell via p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile and calls p11_field_trigger_mine_stairs_prompt to test for up-stairs on the previous floor or down-stairs on the current floor.

name: p11_field_trigger_mine_stairs_prompt
summary: Checks if the mine tile at (grid_x, grid_y) on floor_idx holds stairs (type 2), sets transition flags in 0x8012d510 and event flag 3, opens dialogue box, and ends player action lock.

name: p11_field_cache_mine_grid_pointers
summary: Scans the 10x10 mine floor grid (-0x708..+X, 0x708..-Z, step 400), caches tile pointers with flag bit 3 into 0x8009e5f8, sets mine base drop rate to 10, and clears bit 0x2000 of 0x8012d510.

name: p11_field_populate_mine_floor_tiles
summary: Iterates the 10x10 mine floor grid at g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_trigger_table + g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter*100 and spawns rocks/stumps (type 1) or ladder (type 2) at each cell via p11_field_apply_mine_tile_decal.

name: p11_field_apply_mine_tile_decal
summary: Writes mine floor tile decal bytes/UVs from g_farm_field_apply_mine_tile_flag_1..g_farm_field_apply_mine_tile_value[decal_kind*10] into map polygon descriptor referenced by g_farm_cache_field_tile_pointers_spr_value when walkable bit 8 is set.

name: p11_field_dig_mine_floor_tile
summary: Converts the hoe-target coordinate ahead of the player to a 10x10 mine tile via p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile, reveals stairs down on RNG hit, or rolls an ore/item find via p11_field_roll_mine_ore_or_powerberry.

name: p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile
summary: Converts world XZ position to 10x10 mine grid indices (400-unit cells centered at -2000, +2000), returning 2/3 if out of bounds or bit 8 test on g_farm_cache_field_tile_pointers_spr_value.

name: p11_field_tick_mine_stairs_confirm
summary: Ticks the active mine exit/descend confirmation prompt in 0x8012d510, warping to the waterfall/winter mine entrance on exit or incrementing mine floor g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter on descent.

name: p11_field_roll_mine_ore_or_powerberry
summary: Rolls hm_prng_next(100) against floor-weighted drop table g_farm_field_roll_mine_ore_region/g_farm_field_roll_mine_ore_value_1 for winter/normal mine g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter and gates one-time Power Berry (0x67) or Mystic/item (99) drops via flags 0x60..0x62.

name: p11_field_handle_mine_floor_entry
summary: Checks ladder arrival (g_player_interact_target high u16 == 0x42) or event flag 0x44, places player at ladder tile (g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_counter_spawn_pos, g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_counter_1), clears flag 0x44, and regenerates mine floor via p11_field_set_mine_ladder_spawn_pos.

name: p11_field_set_mine_ladder_spawn_pos
summary: When mine depth g_farm_field_all_mine_floors_player_counter != 0, clears bit 0x1000 in g_gfx_active_map_desc_idx2376 and updates entrance spawn g_gfx_active_map_desc_idx2396..ec and ladder coords g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_cfg16_spawn_pos/16 from g_farm_field_dig_mine_floor_ladder_counter_spawn_pos/1a.
